Environment, effective path permission and current permission-normalization laws are linked. given[p] and its intended function signatures are introduced here as future notation. All added conceptual links point backward after moving Shared pending-liveness immediately after ordinary liveness.
limitations: Author editorial self-review. Extraction and byte ranges do not establish clarity by themselves. Earlier unchanged passages retain the prior review after exact-input comparison. Future notes remain nonnormative.
